blogs.title: Why Your LLM Should Stop Using Tokens: Introducing Byte Latent Transformers
blogs.description: Demystify the shift from fixed vocabulary tokenization to raw byte processing. This post explains how the Byte Latent Transformer (BLT) abandons the rigid constraints of BPE tokenizers to learn directly from data, matching top-tier models like Llama 3 while unlocking unprecedented flexibility in handling diverse languages and complex data.

blogs.title: Smart Compute Allocation: How Dynamic 'Patching' Makes AI Faster and Smarter
blogs.description: Explore the core innovation of BLT: dynamic patching. Learn how this architecture treats text not as a stream of uniform tokens, but as a variable-length puzzle where the model automatically spends more computing power on complex sections (high entropy) and speeds through predictable parts (low entropy), resulting in up to 50% inference savings.

blogs.title: Beyond the Vocabulary: Why Raw Bytes Make AI More Robust Against Noise and Errors
blogs.description: Discover why removing the tokenizer barrier gives models superpowers in robustness. This article dives into experimental results showing how BLT handles noisy inputs, understands phonology, masters orthography (spelling), and excels at low-resource machine translation—tasks where traditional token-based models often stumble.

blogs.title: The New Scaling Law: Growing Models Without Breaking Your Budget
blogs.description: Reveal a new frontier in AI scaling. Instead of trading model size for speed, BLT introduces a paradigm where you can simultaneously increase both model capacity and patch size within a fixed inference budget. Read how this breakthrough allows developers to build massive, efficient models that outperform current standards when compute costs are held constant.
